title: Morocco 2024 HS92 310530: destination spread and world export context

source.observation_kind: reconciled annual bilateral merchandise trade estimates
source.value_unit: thousands of nominal USD; USD columns multiply by exactly 1000
source.decimal_serialization: Exact DECIMAL results are serialized as JSON strings.

product.official_source_label: Fertilizers, mineral or chemical: diammonium hydrogenorthophosphate (diammonium phosphate)

queries.market_and_world_context:
SELECT e.year,e.country_code,e.country_name,e.direction,e.hs6,
 e.total_value_1000usd,e.total_value_usd,e.partner_count,
 e.top1_partner_code,e.top1_share,e.top3_share,e.hhi,
 e.intra_scope_share,e.intra_current_member_share,e.quantity_value_coverage_share,
 g.global_value_1000usd,g.global_value_usd,g.global_supplier_hhi,g.supplier_count,
 cast(e.total_value_1000usd AS DOUBLE)/cast(g.global_value_1000usd AS DOUBLE) AS exporter_share_of_world_product_value,
 e.source_version,e.source_archive_sha256
FROM read_parquet('data/exposures/year=2024/*.parquet',hive_partitioning=false) e
JOIN read_parquet('data/global_context/year=2024/*.parquet',hive_partitioning=false) g USING(year,hs6)
WHERE e.country_code=504 AND e.direction='export' AND e.hs6='310530';
queries.top5_destination_evidence:
SELECT year,hs6,exporter_code,importer_code,importer_name,
 trade_value_1000usd,trade_value_1000usd*1000 AS trade_value_usd,
 cast(trade_value_1000usd AS DOUBLE)/cast(sum(trade_value_1000usd) OVER() AS DOUBLE) AS share_of_all_recorded_destinations,
 source_member,source_record_ordinal,v_raw,q_raw,source_version,source_archive_sha256
FROM read_parquet('data/flows/year=2024/*.parquet',hive_partitioning=false)
WHERE exporter_code=504 AND hs6='310530'
ORDER BY trade_value_1000usd DESC,importer_code LIMIT 5;

interpretation_limits: The top-five result is a display shortlist; its shares retain all 71 recorded destinations in the denominator.
World export share is measured against the full worldwide source stream, not only Arab-touch flows.
This is trade-value distribution, not physical production, supplier capacity, quality or a market-entry recommendation.
Country names preserve the source labels; code 792 has an upstream encoding artifact in its source name.
